SELECT 
    s.NCESSchool
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;

SELECT s.NCESSchool
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;

SELECT 
    s.NCESSchool
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;
SELECT CDSCode FROM frpm WHERE Enrollment_5_17 > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT f.CDSCode, f.School 
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500;

SELECT f.CDSCode
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY f.CDSCode
HAVING SUM(f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT s.NCESSchool
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` + f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT T2.NCESSchool
FROM frpm AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` + T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.NCESSchool
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
GROUP BY T1.NCESSchool
HAVING SUM(T2.`Enrollment (K-12)`) + SUM(T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500;

SELECT School_Code 
FROM frpm 
GROUP BY School_Code 
HAVING SUM(Enrollment (Ages 5-17)) > 500;
